title: Coefficient-compatible counits for proper support
statement: Let D be a finite-field datum, ell a prime distinct from its characteristic, and Omega an algebraic closure of Q_ell in an independent universe. Let p:X→Y be proper over D.k between finite-type quasi-compact schemes. Let S be any specified normalized compact-support coefficient action for (id_X,p) [def-weil-compact-support-coefficient-action]. Let L be a coherent inverse-image stage family whose finite functors and comparison components are precisely the canonical rational pullback and scalar comparison [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom]. Given finite adjunctions a_E:L_E ⊣ S_E, there are natural automorphisms e_E of S_E such that the transported adjunction counits epsilon_E obey L_F(S_beta(h)_K);epsilon_F(T_X(h)K) = L_beta(h)^(-1)_(S_E K);T_X(h)(epsilon_E(K)) for every finite coefficient inclusion h:E≤F and every K at E. This asserts a normalization of already supplied finite adjunctions, not their existence, common-stage descent, an open adjunction, or a compactification compositor.

source.place: Proper image paragraph, together with SGA 4 XVII §5 and Bhatt--Scholze 6.7.2 and 6.7.6–6.7.7. Separate finite-stage compatibility assertion needed in the common-stage comparison.

proof.text: The normalized integral proper adjunction is obtained by restricting the reduction/system adjunction and transporting identity-open removal; its rationalization gives finite adjunctions. The finite proper-support adjunction theorem establishes their existence separately. For any supplied adjunctions, right-adjoint uniqueness compares them with these normalized ones by natural automorphisms of their fixed right functors.

On full derived quotient systems remove the identity-open factor. The normalized compact-support scalar arrow is the transpose of scalar extension of the direct-image counit. The scalar pullback comparison is the balanced-tensor comparison. Triangle identities show that the two displayed counit composites have the same transpose. The whole-system normalization preserves quotient transitions, so this is equality before total limit, not an inference from separate finite evaluations.

Apply the fixed total-limit realization, restrict to constructible subcategories, and rationalize the equation on pure tensors. Conjugate by the canonical stage-transition isomorphisms and the supplied finite-functor equalities. This yields exactly the displayed counit equation. Empty schemes, zero objects, and identity field inclusions obey the same triangle identities. Finally transport the supplied adjunctions by the right-adjoint uniqueness automorphisms to get precisely these normalized counits; the transport formulas for unit and counit identify the stated equations.

theorem properSupportCoefficientAdjunction
    (D : FiniteFieldDatum.{u}) (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (hl : l ≠ D.p)
    (Ω : Type v) [Field Ω] [Algebra ℚ_[l] Ω] [IsAlgClosure ℚ_[l] Ω]
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}}
    [X.Over (Spec (.of D.k))] [Y.Over (Spec (.of D.k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (.of D.k))] [QuasiCompact (X ↘ Spec (.of D.k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (Y ↘ Spec (.of D.k))] [QuasiCompact (Y ↘ Spec (.of D.k))]
    (p : X ⟶ Y) [p.IsOver (Spec (.of D.k))] [IsProper p]
    [∀ x : X, Invertible (l : X.residueField x)]
    [∀ y : Y, Invertible (l : Y.residueField y)] :
    ∀ (S : SfCompactSupportCoefficientAction l D.k (finiteFieldDatumPrimeUnit D l hl) Ω
        (Compactification.ofIsProper p))
      (L : (stageSystem l Ω Y).Morphism
        (stageSystem l Ω X)),
      L.Φ = (fun E ↦ rationalDerivedPullback l (Coefficient.{u} l Ω E)
        p) →
      (∀ (E F : Index l Ω) (h : E ≤ F)
        (K : Stage l Ω Y E),
        HEq ((L.β h).app K)
          (commonStagePullbackComparison l Ω p ⟨E, K⟩ F h)) →
      ∀ a : ∀ E, L.Φ E ⊣ S.system.Φ E,
      ∃ e : ∀ E, S.system.Φ E ≅ S.system.Φ E,
        ∀ {E F : Index l Ω} (h : E ≤ F)
          (K : Stage l Ω X E),
          (L.Φ F).map ((S.system.β h).hom.app K) ≫
            ((a F).ofNatIsoRight (e F)).counit.app (((stageSystem l Ω X).T h).obj K) =
          (L.β h).inv.app ((S.system.Φ E).obj K) ≫
            ((stageSystem l Ω X).T h).map
              (((a E).ofNatIsoRight (e E)).counit.app K)
